detailed_description:
Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:07. The shot begins from <Picture 3>: a full shot of the plateau: a tall gaunt man in a dark velveteen tunic standing at the shaded foot of a giant boulder with a long rifle hanging down from one hand, the bare grey rock running away past him to the plateau edge, and the plain far below beyond it. The camera is on the bare rock of the plateau, level with a standing man's chest and five long strides from the boulder, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera. At the first frame A giant boulder stands at the LEFT of frame from the BOTTOM to the TOP with its shaded face toward the camera. The camera pushes in on the man across the whole shot, travelling two long strides as he turns his head from the plain to the north and back at a normal walking pace, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 the heat shimmer moves on the rock behind him, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot.
